name: AgentGym Benchmark Suite
description: A benchmark suite within the AgentGym framework designed to evaluate large language model-based agents across diverse environments and tasks, supporting real-time, uni-format, and concurrent agent exploration with a database of instructions and high-quality trajectories.
reputation: A recent agent benchmark suite from the AgentGym framework that is still emerging, with growing interest but limited established community adoption so far.
notes: Includes a platform, dataset, benchmark, checkpoints, and algorithm implementations; supports agent self-evolution across tasks and environments.
